title: Draft Written Statement under Order VIII CPC (India)
instructions: Review the attached plaint, supporting documents, and cause list. Draft a written statement for the defendant under Order VIII of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, responding to each material allegation and raising appropriate preliminary objections. Output: `written-statement.docx`.

criteria.title: Written statement deliverable produced
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if a written statement document (written-statement.docx or equivalent) is produced. FAIL if no written statement is drafted.

criteria.title: Responds to material allegations paragraph-wise
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the draft responds to the plaint's material allegations in a paragraph-wise or issue-wise structure consistent with Order VIII CPC. FAIL if major paragraphs of the plaint are unaddressed.

criteria.title: Raises limitation preliminary objection where applicable
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the draft raises a preliminary objection on limitation under the Limitation Act, 1963 when the plaint shows a stale cause of action. FAIL if a clear limitation defect visible in the plaint is ignored.

criteria.title: Addresses jurisdiction (pecuniary/territorial)
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the draft addresses territorial or pecuniary jurisdiction where facts in the plaint create a triable issue. FAIL if an obvious jurisdiction defect pleaded in the documents is not addressed.

criteria.title: Includes verification as required
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the draft includes or flags a verification clause consistent with Order VI Rule 15 and Order VIII CPC practice. FAIL if verification is entirely omitted without comment.

criteria.title: Sets out specific denial vs evasive denial
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if denials distinguish specific denials from evasive denials and do not blanket-deny paragraphs that admit documentary facts. FAIL if the draft uses only conclusory blanket denials.

title: Draft Arbitration Notice under Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 (India)
instructions: Review the contract, correspondence, and breach chronology. Draft a Section 21 notice invoking arbitration under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, nominating an arbitrator or proposing a tribunal as per the clause. Output: `arbitration-notice.docx`.

criteria.title: Arbitration notice deliverable produced
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if an arbitration notice (arbitration-notice.docx or equivalent) is produced. FAIL if missing.

criteria.title: Identifies arbitration agreement and seat
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the notice quotes or identifies the arbitration clause, institution/rules, and seat/venue in India. FAIL if the clause is not identified.

criteria.title: States dispute and relief claimed
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the notice summarizes the dispute, breach dates, and relief sought (damages/specific performance). FAIL if relief is not stated.

criteria.title: Proposes arbitrator or procedure
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the notice proposes a sole arbitrator or tribunal appointment consistent with the clause (party-nominated / institutional). FAIL if appointment procedure is omitted.

criteria.title: Compliance window for response
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the notice sets a reasonable response period for counterparty nomination or consent. FAIL if no timeline for next steps is provided.

criteria.title: Reservation of rights and governing law
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the notice reserves rights and references governing law of India / contract law. FAIL if governing framework is absent.

title: Analyze SARFAESI Section 13(2) Notice and Borrower Response Strategy (India)
instructions: Review the Section 13(2) demand notice, loan documents, and account statements. Prepare a memo on enforceability, procedural defects, and borrower response options including representation under Section 13(3A). Output: `sarfaesi-response-memo.docx`.

criteria.title: SARFAESI response memo produced
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if sarfaesi-response-memo.docx or equivalent analysis memo is produced. FAIL if missing.

criteria.title: Quantifies outstanding as per notice
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo states the demanded amount and reconciles it with loan statements. FAIL if amounts are not discussed.

criteria.title: Reviews security interest and possession stage
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo identifies secured asset, charge registration, and whether action is pre-13(4) symbolic/physical possession. FAIL if security stage is ignored.

criteria.title: Identifies procedural defects if any
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo tests notice service, authorized officer certification, and six-month limitation themes. FAIL if procedural compliance is not analyzed.

criteria.title: Sets out Section 13(3A) representation option
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo explains borrower representation/objection avenue and 60-day creditor reply obligation. FAIL if 13(3A) is omitted.

criteria.title: Notes DRT appeal / injunction routes
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo references appeal to DRT under Section 17 and practical stay/injunction considerations. FAIL if remedies are not outlined.

title: Analyze CCI Combination Filing Requirement for Indian Acquisition (India)
instructions: Review the share purchase term sheet, target and acquirer group turnover/asset data, and market share slides. Prepare a CCI filing necessity memo under the Competition Act, 2002 and Combination Regulations. Output: `cci-filing-memo.docx`.

criteria.title: CCI filing memo produced
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if cci-filing-memo.docx or equivalent is produced. FAIL if missing.

criteria.title: Applies assets/turnover thresholds
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo applies current Combination Regulations thresholds in India and group attribution logic. FAIL if thresholds are not discussed.

criteria.title: Assesses trigger events and timing
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo identifies whether the transaction is a notifiable combination and the filing trigger (execution vs closing per chosen test). FAIL if timing is ignored.

criteria.title: Discusses gun-jumping risk
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo warns against implementation before approval and notes standstill obligations. FAIL if gun-jumping is not mentioned.

criteria.title: Outlines Form I vs Form II factors
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo discusses whether a short Form I or detailed Form II is likely based on overlaps. FAIL if form strategy is absent.

criteria.title: Recommends filing timeline and next steps
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo recommends filing timeline, data requests, and closing condition linkage. FAIL if no actionable recommendation.

title: Draft DPDP Act Consent and Notice Framework (India)
instructions: Review the product data flow diagram, existing privacy policy, and vendor list. Draft a consent and notice pack aligned with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 for a B2C mobile application. Output: `dpdp-notice-consent.docx`.

criteria.title: DPDP notice/consent pack produced
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if dpdp-notice-consent.docx or equivalent is produced. FAIL if missing.

criteria.title: Lists personal data categories and purposes
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the draft lists data categories collected and specific purposes of processing. FAIL if purposes are vague or missing.

criteria.title: Addresses consent and withdrawal mechanics
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the draft explains how consent is obtained, is free/specific/informed, and how withdrawal works. FAIL if consent mechanics are omitted.

criteria.title: Includes data principal rights section
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the draft covers access, correction, erasure, grievance redressal, and nomination concepts under DPDP. FAIL if rights section is absent.

criteria.title: Grievance officer and contact details
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if a grievance officer / DPO contact and response timeline are specified. FAIL if grievance channel is missing.

criteria.title: Children's data flag if applicable
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the draft flags verifiable parental consent where children's data may be processed, or states age-gating approach. FAIL if children's processing risk is ignored when product is consumer-facing.

title: Analyze Wrongful Termination under Industrial Disputes Act (India)
instructions: Review the employment contract, termination letter, disciplinary inquiry papers, and POSH records. Prepare a memo on legality of termination and forum options (labour court / industrial tribunal). Output: `termination-legality-memo.docx`.

criteria.title: Termination legality memo produced
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if termination-legality-memo.docx or equivalent is produced. FAIL if missing.

criteria.title: Classifies workman vs managerial status
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo analyzes whether the employee is a 'workman' under ID Act based on duties. FAIL if status is assumed without analysis.

criteria.title: Tests domestic inquiry fairness
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo reviews charge sheet, enquiry notice, cross-examination opportunity, and enquiry officer independence. FAIL if inquiry steps are not reviewed.

criteria.title: Addresses Section 25F / retrenchment compensation
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if retrenchment compensation and notice pay themes are discussed when retrenchment is alleged. FAIL if statutory payment obligations are ignored.

criteria.title: Identifies appropriate forum and limitation
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo identifies labour court/industrial tribunal route and applicable limitation themes. FAIL if forum advice is absent.

criteria.title: Recommends settlement vs litigation posture
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo recommends a practical employer response (reinstatement, compensation, settlement). FAIL if no recommendation.

title: Draft Trademark Opposition Reply under Trade Marks Act, 1999 (India)
instructions: Review the opposition notice, applicant's mark usage evidence, and search report. Draft a reply to the opposition before the Registrar under the Trade Marks Act, 1999. Output: `tm-opposition-reply.docx`.

criteria.title: Opposition reply produced
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if tm-opposition-reply.docx or equivalent is produced. FAIL if missing.

criteria.title: Responds to grounds in opposition
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the reply addresses each ground (similarity, confusion, prior use, bad faith). FAIL if major grounds are unanswered.

criteria.title: Pleads prior use/acquired distinctiveness
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the reply pleads prior use with dates and documentary references where available. FAIL if use evidence is not leveraged.

criteria.title: Distinguishes goods/services and class
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the reply distinguishes classes and trade channels to rebut confusion. FAIL if distinction argument is absent.

criteria.title: Includes verification and annexures
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if verification and annexure list are included or flagged. FAIL if procedural completeness is ignored.

criteria.title: Notes evidence stage and timeline
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the reply notes affidavit/evidence stage deadlines under Trademark Rules. FAIL if next procedural steps are omitted.

title: Analyze RERA Delay Compensation Claim against Builder (India)
instructions: Review the allotment letter, RERA registration, possession timeline, and delay notices. Prepare a homebuyer claim memo under the Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016. Output: `rera-claim-memo.docx`.

criteria.title: RERA claim memo produced
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if rera-claim-memo.docx or equivalent is produced. FAIL if missing.

criteria.title: States promised vs actual possession dates
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if promised possession and actual/expected delay months are stated. FAIL if timeline is missing.

criteria.title: Calculates interest/compensation approach
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo proposes compensation methodology under RERA (interest/refund options). FAIL if relief math is absent.

criteria.title: Checks project registration and advertisements
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if RERA registration validity and marketing representations are reviewed. FAIL if registration status ignored.

criteria.title: Addresses forum (RERA authority vs consumer commission)
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo compares RERA authority and Consumer Commission routes with a recommendation. FAIL if forum analysis missing.

criteria.title: Lists documentary annexures for filing
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo lists required annexures (allotment, receipts, correspondence). FAIL if filing checklist absent.

title: Analyze GST Show Cause Notice Reply Strategy (India)
instructions: Review the GST show cause notice, GSTR filings, e-way bills, and contracts. Prepare a reply strategy memo addressing tax, interest, and penalty sections. Output: `gst-scn-reply-memo.docx`.

criteria.title: GST SCN reply memo produced
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if gst-scn-reply-memo.docx or equivalent is produced. FAIL if missing.

criteria.title: Identifies allegations period and sections
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo states SCN period, sections invoked, and demand breakup (tax/interest/penalty). FAIL if demand not summarized.

criteria.title: Maps documentary defense to each allegation
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if each major allegation is matched to supporting documents or legal arguments. FAIL if allegations are not itemized.

criteria.title: Addresses ITC eligibility / valuation themes
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if ITC denial or valuation mismatch arguments are analyzed on merits. FAIL if core tax issue ignored.

criteria.title: Notes limitation and personal liability
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo flags limitation under CGST Act and personal penalty on officers if alleged. FAIL if procedural defenses omitted.

criteria.title: Recommends reply timeline and hearing preparation
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo sets a reply calendar and hearing strategy. FAIL if no timeline.

title: Analyze ED PMLA Summons and Statement Strategy (India)
instructions: Review the ED summons, predicate offence FIR, and transaction trail. Prepare a client advisory on appearance, document production, and statement rights under PMLA. Output: `ed-pmla-advisory.docx`.

criteria.title: ED/PMLA advisory produced
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if ed-pmla-advisory.docx or equivalent is produced. FAIL if missing.

criteria.title: Explains scheduled appearance obligations
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the advisory explains summons compliance and consequences of non-appearance. FAIL if attendance obligations not discussed.

criteria.title: Maps predicate scheduled offence linkage
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the advisory connects alleged proceeds to a scheduled offence narrative in the FIR/material. FAIL if predicate linkage ignored.

criteria.title: Document production and privilege plan
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the advisory lists documents in scope and flags privilege/limitation on voluntary production. FAIL if production plan absent.

criteria.title: Statement under PMLA cautions
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the advisory notes statement recording implications and right to counsel approach. FAIL if statement risks not addressed.

criteria.title: Bail/attachment parallel track noted
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the advisory notes possible attachment orders and bail forums (PMLA special provisions). FAIL if parallel remedies omitted.

title: Outline CCI Leniency Application Strategy (India)
instructions: Review internal emails, pricing sheets, and industry association meeting notes. Prepare a confidential leniency strategy outline under the CCI (Lesser Penalty) Regulations. Output: `cci-leniency-outline.docx`.

criteria.title: Leniency outline produced
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if cci-leniency-outline.docx or equivalent is produced. FAIL if missing.

criteria.title: Identifies alleged cartel conduct and participants
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the outline describes conduct (price fixing/bid rigging) and participants at high level. FAIL if conduct not described.

criteria.title: Assesses marker/ranking benefits
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the outline explains first-in marker advantages and cooperation duties. FAIL if leniency benefits not explained.

criteria.title: Lists evidence to be proffered
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the outline lists documentary and witness evidence available to CCI. FAIL if evidence plan missing.

criteria.title: Flags dawn raid and document hold
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if immediate litigation hold and dawn raid readiness steps are noted. FAIL if preservation steps absent.

criteria.title: Recommends counsel engagement and timeline
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the outline recommends urgent counsel engagement before contacting CCI. FAIL if no timeline.

title: Draft Board Resolution under Companies Act, 2013 (India)
instructions: Review the transaction term sheet and charter documents. Draft a board resolution approving the transaction, authorized signatories, and filings (PAS-3/MGT-14 as applicable). Output: `board-resolution.docx`.

criteria.title: Board resolution produced
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if board-resolution.docx or equivalent is produced. FAIL if missing.

criteria.title: Recites meeting compliance
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the resolution recites notice, quorum, and authority under AoA/Companies Act. FAIL if meeting compliance omitted.

criteria.title: Approves specified transaction
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the resolution clearly approves the transaction described in the term sheet. FAIL if approval object is vague.

criteria.title: Authorizes signatories and filings
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if directors/officers are authorized to sign and file ROC forms. FAIL if authorization missing.

criteria.title: Notes Section 180/188 approvals if needed
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if borrowing, guarantee, related party or other special resolutions are flagged when triggers appear. FAIL if obvious Section 180/188 needs ignored.

criteria.title: Includes certification block
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if director/CS certification block is included. FAIL if execution block absent.
